name: Shanghai Golden Bridge Info Tech Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Golden Bridge Info Tech Co.,Ltd (SGBIT) is a Chinese provider specializing in the delivery of multimedia information systems, industry-specific solutions, and related services. Its comprehensive portfolio encompasses cutting-edge multimedia conference systems, critical emergency command center platforms, and advanced solutions designed for science and technology courts, in addition to a variety of other tailored on-site services. The firm, headquartered in Shanghai, China, has been a key player in the market since its establishment in 1994.
